lesson: The trade failed because it prioritized 15m bullish momentum against a dominant 4h/1d bearish market structure, leading to a classic trend-continuation trap. The system incorrectly identified a local higher-low as a reversal point rather than a liquidity sweep within a larger distribution phase.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 4h timeframe before entering any long positions, regardless of 15m bullish patterns.
methodology_flag: Trust HTF market structure over LTF momentum indicators.
